attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2780/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives both years in its narrative as well as in the heading, with the date of death in full. The line's own rank word for him is εθνοιερομάρτυρας, a national hieromartyr, for which the corpus's vocabulary has only `hieromartyr`; the national part of it is said here and not in `types`. The corpus holds `leo-of-methone` and no other saint of that see. No coordinate is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
